purpose: Protect Prompt Kit behavior across ADD, EDIT/STRENGTHEN, and RETIRE by making each prompt's accepted semantic capabilities versioned repository truth.

baseline.reason: Sprint 0 floor: schemas and PSC rules established; baseline profile matrix population is Sprint 1A.

invariants.rule: PROFILE_COVERAGE_COMPLETE — every current prompt has exactly one ACCEPTED profile before strict enforcement may activate.
PROFILE_BINDS_CANONICAL_PROMPT — accepted profile binds to exact prompt identity and canonical record hash.
KNOWN_CAPABILITY_ONLY — every assignment references the stable catalog.
REQUIRED_PRESENCE_NON_WEAKENING — REQUIRED may not fall to SUPPORT/AWARE/NONE without an explicit accepted migration.
PRIMARY_OWNERSHIP_NON_WEAKENING — PRIMARY may not fall to SECONDARY/NONE unless responsibility is explicitly transferred or intentionally retired with coverage proof.
TRANSFER_EQUAL_OR_STRONGER — a transfer is accepted only when successor coverage is equal-or-stronger for the protected capability and required proof exists.
RETIRE_NO_COVERAGE_HOLE — retirement fails if it produces an uncovered previously protected capability.
ADD_REQUIRES_DISTINCT_RESIDUAL — P79 cannot ADD when topology/profile overlap shows an existing owner can absorb the use case without a reviewed distinct residual.
BODY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_PROFILE_DISPOSITION — any changed canonical prompt body must have a capability migration or an exact no-capability-change attestation bound to focused proof.
SAME_AGENT_RESCORING_CANNOT_RESET_PRIOR — generated/proposed candidate profiles cannot replace accepted history.
NEW_PRIMARY_OR_REQUIRED_REQUIRES_PROOF — strengthening claims need evidence, not just a higher self-assigned rating.
GLOBAL_PRIMARY_CROWDING_REVIEW — unexpected multiple PRIMARY owners trigger configured warning/fail policy.
SOURCE_HISTORY_COMPLETE — every canonical prompt body source, including docs/prompts.json, is covered by Prompt Quality History.
LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_ATOMIC — ADD/STRENGTHEN/RETIRE cannot leave registry, profile, migration, generated site, or required semantic proof mutually inconsistent.
SOURCE_AND_CAPABILITY_MIGRATION_LINK — body-changing profile transitions must reference the matching Prompt Quality History semantic migration and agree on source hashes/affected IDs.

INHERITED_SOURCE_INTEGRITY — shared policy/compiler capability inheritance is versioned by source identity/revision; dependent matrix cells cannot remain accepted against a changed inherited source without revalidation.

EXISTING_PROMPT_PROFILE_ADOPTION — an existing unprofiled prompt may enter ACCEPTED coverage without a body mutation only through the semantic-coverage lifecycle owner, with exact canonical binding, reviewed evidence, no pre-existing profile history, atomic validation, and no fabricated Prompt Quality History migration.

HOLISTIC_NON_WEAKENING_MUTATION_LIFECYCLE — every protected ADD, EDIT/STRENGTHEN, TRANSFER, or RETIRE must compare before/after semantic state and preserve the effective Prompt Kit portfolio. STRENGTHEN and NO_CAPABILITY_CHANGE may not reduce any accepted presence/ownership cell. Compression is a semantic-density operation: remove redundancy before removing obligations, ownership boundaries, failure handling, proof requirements, continuation semantics, or lifecycle history. Any intentional semantic reduction must use an explicit lifecycle disposition with evidence, and transferred/retired responsibility must remain equal-or-stronger elsewhere.

principles: Prompt strength is measured by preserved or increased accepted semantics and effective portfolio coverage, not by character count.
Compression is preferred when wording is repetitive or a prompt approaches its representation budget, but compression may remove only redundancy, never protected behavior or ownership.
Compare before and after canonical body, accepted semantic profile, effective shared-policy inheritance, focused regression coverage, and portfolio coverage before accepting a mutation.
ADD must prove a distinct residual and compact bounded identity; it must not duplicate an owner merely to avoid editing a dense prompt.
EDIT/STRENGTHEN must choose an explicit compression disposition and preserve all prior accepted capability presence/ownership unless a stronger explicit lifecycle operation owns the transfer.
RETIRE must preserve equal-or-stronger coverage, tombstone/history, and successor routing; deletion for tidiness is not retirement.
Character ceilings are design budgets. Near a ceiling, first compact repetition and shared-policy prose before dropping unique semantics.
Generated HTML and prose volume are never semantic authority; canonical source, profiles, migrations, contracts, tests, and effective composition are.
mutation_lifecycle.proof_ceiling: Repository semantic/profile/history and mutation-gate proof only. This contract does not prove downstream model obedience, operator acceptance, runtime behavior, deployment, or that prose quality can be reduced to character counts.
